scope: Official FuzDrop frontend export-format audit only; no prediction was submitted.

source_coordinates.offset_unit: Unicode code points in decoded source

scores_tsv.row_selection: Rows whose position is not null, preserving result-array order.
scores_tsv.value_serialization: Optional toString() calls; no explicit numeric rounding in the exporter.
scores_tsv.delivery: A browser-created data:text/plain;charset=utf-8 URI, not a downloadable static server file.
scores_tsv.missing_numeric_serialization: The optional toString() expression returns undefined for null or undefined numeric fields; concatenation with TAB strings serializes the literal text undefined. This is source-code evidence, not an observed real export.

regions_tsv.row_order: All native DPR records, then all native aggregation-hotspot records; array order retained.

global_pLLPS.observed_location: The frontend result-page template interpolates the pLLPS service field.
global_pLLPS.manual_import_consequence: Only a separately user-copied visible global value can be accepted as user-supplied provenance. It must never be derived from residue pDP.

observations: The score exporter preserves native position values without arithmetic.
The region exporter preserves native start/end values without arithmetic.
The pDP plot uses native residue positions unchanged.
The structure viewer passes native start/end unchanged as author-residue-number bounds.
coordinate_evidence.interpretation: Structure-viewer mapping is suggestive of biological residue numbering but does not independently establish TSV indexing or endpoint inclusivity.

native_regions_versus_graph.consequence: Preserve imported native region records. Do not infer the complete exported region set from visible plot bars, or apply these display filters to imported regions.

public_example_audit.button_action: Sets the accession input field; does not load a precomputed result.
public_example_audit.results_state: Result fields are held in frontend service state.
search_scope: The current predictor HTML and its explicitly referenced main bundle.
Official-domain web searches for result/example/export TSV pages.
public_example_audit.limitation: No exhaustive absence claim is made. No guessed result URLs or private endpoints were requested.

manual_import_validation_recommendations.status: Proposed defensive contract, separate from verified official-format facts.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.provenance: User-provided official-format TSV; successful parsing does not authenticate the origin or claim a new official prediction.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.coordinates: Require an explicit one_based_inclusive declaration; do not auto-detect or silently shift coordinates. Retain that this is a user declaration, not an independently verified official convention.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.scores: Require the exact four official columns. Validate contiguous unique integer positions 1..N and full residue-by-residue agreement with the supplied canonical sequence. Require nonmissing pDP values to be finite and in [0,1]. Preserve empty numeric cells and official literal undefined as null; reject NaN/Infinity and unsupported numeric tokens. Require nonmissing Sbind to be nonnegative and finite, without an undocumented upper bound.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.regions: Require the exact three official columns and the two documented native labels only. Validate integer bounds 1 <= start <= end <= N under the declared coordinate convention. Preserve native values, types, and order without length filters or reconstruction.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.global: An optional separately copied pLLPS value must be finite and in [0,1], with explicit user-supplied provenance. Missing pLLPS remains null.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.absence: A missing regions file means not supplied (null); a supplied valid header-only regions file means an explicitly empty native list. Never substitute fabricated scores or regions.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.transport: UTF-8 text, optional UTF-8 BOM and LF/CRLF normalization may be accepted by the local importer; this is parser tolerance, not a claim about additional official export dialects.
manual_import_validation_recommendations.safety: No prediction request, CAPTCHA interaction, hidden endpoint probe, or local FuzDrop download is needed for this contract.

sample_policy: No prediction-score sample has been generated or represented as real. Any future parser fixtures must explicitly label synthetic data and retain this absence of a genuine exported sample.
